test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true even if they do not conform to real-world knowledge, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All uncles are relatives.

2. Some relatives are neighbours.

3. All neighbours are employed.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some neighbours are uncles.

II. Some uncles are employed.

III. Some relatives are employed.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fe868737d2bbf657c87c92a27247685ba69d876b0b5d0b38f853d0506de1c96.png] 

I) Some neighbours are uncles → **Does not follow** → As all uncle are relatives and some relatives are neighbours. We can not say anything about some neighbours are uncles.

II) Some uncles are employed → **Does not follow** → As all uncles are reatives, some relative are neighbours and All neighbours are employed so from this statement we can not say anything about some uncles are employed. It could be possible or not.

III) Some relatives are employed → **Follow **→ As some relatives are neighbours and All neighbours are employed. It means some relative who are neighbours are definitely employed.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion III follows".**
